title: Tensor products of globally generated invertible sheaves are globally generated
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_n$ be globally generated invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Then the tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] $\mathcal L_1\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\cdots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L_n$ is a globally generated invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module, generated by the tensor products of global generating sections of the factors.
